description.value: BC Ferries Connector runs coach service between downtown Vancouver / YVR and downtown Victoria, connecting through the Tsawwassen–Swartz Bay ferry crossing. Bikes are accepted but must be boxed or bagged (no roll-on) for $42 CAD per bike, 50 lb max, with a bike reservation recommended. Note that the same operator's separate Vancouver Island Connector (the Victoria–Nanaimo–Parksville–Courtenay–Campbell River touring corridor) is currently suspended with no announced restart date. Confirm current fees and status directly before travel.

wow_evidence: Scheduled coach network on southern Vancouver Island and the Victoria to Vancouver corridor
